sn_aia_version.instructions: 1. Identify which AI asset (model, prompt, or AI system) the user is asking about. 2. Query the AICT KG Data Agent knowledge graph for that asset's governance and lifecycle facts: status, last certification date, compliance flags, and related AI system. 3. Call the Jev Decision Check skill, passing a prompt input built as: TYPE:noul, INSTRUCTIONS:<the user's maintenance question>, STATE:<the retrieved governance facts>. 4. Present Jev's structured answer to the user, including the probability or confidence value it returned, alongside the governance facts used.
